rows.text: The Grove of Epiphany has issued its Intern Scholar Examination — an open call across all of Amphoreus. After twenty long years of academic toil, you know this is a chance you cannot let slip away.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The competition is staggering, with countless hopefuls vying for just three precious spots. You force yourself to calm the excitement buzzing in your veins — focus. The real question is: which of your research projects should you submit?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your scholarly pursuits span a dizzying array of fields, but in academia, raw merit isn't everything — Submitting something the panel likes is just as crucial.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: How bath salts of different compositions affect skin.
Study the possibility of artificially creating golden blood through alchemy.
Outrageous! Researching golden blood — is that even ethical? But... you have to admit, the subject is rather fascinating.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
